economic_hypothesis: Point-in-time selected Hyperliquid wallet cohorts may reveal opening, closing, TWAP and liquidation inventory transitions before the full move is incorporated into executable Bybit USDT-linear perpetual prices.

source_probe.trust_policy: Do not trust advertised coverage or schema until endpoint responses and file inventory are recorded.

allowed_operations: record HTTP status, headers and raw JSON responses
extract filenames, byte sizes, advertised dates and version identifiers
prohibited_operations: download or read outcome-bearing parquet rows

minimum_requirements: at least one usable Kaggle metadata or file-list endpoint
file-level inventory or explicit source-access failure
inventory_gate.minimum_coverage_for_future_public_sampl: Enough chronology for a prior-only wallet estimation interval and at least two distinct development partitions. Otherwise no PnL is permitted from this sample.
